title: Sources: DeepSeek is in talks to raise funds, and the Big Fund, China's biggest state-backed chip fund, is seeking to lead the investment at a ~$45B valuation (Financial Times)
commentary: China's state chip fund leading a DeepSeek round is the geopolitical equivalent of the government buying a controlling stake in its own AI champion — $45B valuation for a lab that rattled Silicon Valley with a cheap model, now getting Beijing's full institutional backing.
